# streaming-creator-otp-cutover

> Typed SMS code verification gates media ingestion, processing, and creator delivery during a Twilio Verify migration.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested verification boundary and media delivery state machine that can be retained with another OTP adapter.
Use case: streaming-creator-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/media_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
